title: Notice Date of an Entrance Fee Agreement Cancellation Before Occupancy
content:
Desk guidance on the **notice date** of a cancellation of an **Entrance Fee Agreement** before occupancy.

**Rule.** The notice date of a cancellation is fixed as follows: where a cancellation request on the agreement was registered by Larkspur and still awaits the resident's signature, the notice date is the day that request was registered; where no cancellation request awaits signature but the independent living reservation paired with the agreement was cancelled, the notice date is the day that reservation was closed; in every other case the notice date is the day the cancellation is signed.

Where more than one cancellation request on the agreement awaits signature, the latest one registered gives the day.

## What the records show

- **Cancellation request awaiting signature**: a pre-occupancy cancellation request on the agreement's request record, registered by Larkspur on a given day and still awaiting the resident's signature.
- **Paired reservation cancelled**: the Independent Living Residency Agreement named in the Entrance Fee Agreement stands cancelled, with the day the reservation was closed on its record.

## Condition table

| Cancellation request awaiting signature | Paired independent living reservation cancelled | Notice date |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | Day the request was registered |
| Yes | No | Day the request was registered |
| No | Yes | Day the reservation was closed |
| No | No | Day the cancellation is signed |

## Hypothetical cases

- A request was registered on 3 April and awaits signature; the resident signs on 20 April. Notice date: 3 April.
- No request awaits signature; the paired independent living reservation was closed as cancelled on 28 March; the resident signs on 20 April. Notice date: 28 March.
- Neither record exists and the resident signs on 20 April. Notice date: 20 April.
